title: Phase 6C Task G: Forensic Error Analysis & Visual Attribution

forensic_case_audits.anatomical_mechanism: Focal subsegmental atelectasis produces small linear band opacities (<2% of lung volume). GAP spatial averaging dilutes activation.
forensic_case_audits.radiological_confounder: Basilar discoid atelectasis frequently overlaps with diaphragmatic tenting and pleural thickening.
forensic_case_audits.view_position_bias: PA upright view; clear costophrenic angles differentiate from pleural effusion.

forensic_case_audits.primary_error_mode: Probability Suppression via Direct Resizing (80.46% vs 90.44% letterbox)
forensic_case_audits.anatomical_mechanism: Aspect ratio distortion (19.4% horizontal squashing) compresses transverse cardiac diameter, directly reducing computed CTR.
forensic_case_audits.radiological_confounder: Inspiratory effort: shallow inspiration raises diaphragm, widening apparent cardiac silhouette; deep inspiration narrows it.
forensic_case_audits.view_position_bias: AP portable projection magnifies cardiac silhouette by 10-15% due to divergence of X-ray beam.

forensic_case_audits.anatomical_mechanism: Interstitial edema presents as fine perihilar haze and Kerley B lines. Low resolution (224x224) blurs these sub-millimeter findings.
forensic_case_audits.radiological_confounder: Fluid overload frequently co-exists with cardiomegaly (28.6% co-occurrence in NIH), causing network to focus solely on heart size.
forensic_case_audits.view_position_bias: Supine patient positioning redistributes fluid cephalad into upper lung zones.

forensic_case_audits.primary_error_mode: True Positive (88.71% > 0.7329), but high co-activation with Pneumonia (73.69%)
forensic_case_audits.anatomical_mechanism: Dense lobar alveolar filling with air bronchograms. High feature saliency correctly detected across all models.
forensic_case_audits.radiological_confounder: Pathological overlap: dense consolidation is the definitive radiographic manifestation of bacterial pneumonia.
forensic_case_audits.view_position_bias: PA view; sharp demarcation along horizontal fissure indicates right middle lobe consolidation.

forensic_case_audits.anatomical_mechanism: The classifier assigns higher probability to Consolidation than Pneumonia due to NLP training label ambiguity.
forensic_case_audits.radiological_confounder: Radiology reports commonly dictate 'consolidation suspicious for pneumonia', leading to dual label noise.
forensic_case_audits.view_position_bias: Patchy bronchopneumonic opacities lack sharp margins, confounding localized feature heads.

forensic_case_audits.anatomical_mechanism: Apical visceral pleural white line is sub-millimeter (<1 mm). Standard 224x224 downsampling averages out pleural edge contrast.
forensic_case_audits.radiological_confounder: Skin folds, clothing artifacts, and rib margins mimic or obscure apical pleural lines.
forensic_case_audits.view_position_bias: Erect expiration CXR increases radiographic visibility of small pneumothoraces.

pneumothorax_detection_barriers: Apical edge attenuation at low spatial resolutions (<384x384).
Clavicle and anterior rib superposition in portable radiographs.
Absence of expiratory comparison radiographs in standard screening protocols.
pneumonia_consolidation_entanglement: Lobar pneumonia and alveolar consolidation share identical radiographic density.
32.4% co-occurrence in training ground truth labels generated by NLP report parsers.
Grad-CAM heatmaps confirm identical spatial attention maps over lower lung opacities.
projection_and_acquisition_confounders: AP projection naturally magnifies anterior mediastinal structures compared to standard PA geometry.
Suboptimal patient inspiration artificially inflates cardiothoracic ratio by 8%-14%.

rule_reminder: Image filenames must NEVER be treated as clinical ground truth. Reference labels require verified radiological consensus.
